neighbours.label: the padding dots inside an ADS-style bibcode: a four-digit year glued to a journal abbreviation, then dots, then a volume number (e.g. 1997Icar..128..99Q), in any field (astronomy, physics, geoscience), strongest on real journal abbreviations; made-up codes of the same year+letters+dots shape fire more weakly, and the code without its year is weak; quiet on ordinary ellipses, version numbers, IP addresses, page ranges, DOIs, arXiv ids and journal citations written without a bibcode
fire: The crater statistics were taken from 1997Icar..128..99Q and compared with newer imaging.
See 2004ApJ...600..580B for the original derivation of the luminosity function.
Our reference list includes 1995A&A...300..707S, which first reported the line.
The bibcode 2010MNRAS.402..123K points to the paper on galaxy mergers.
Seismic velocities follow 1981PEPI...25..297D, the standard Earth model.
He pasted 2001JGR...10625279A into the search box and the abstract came up at once.
Magnetic reconnection rates were measured as in 1999PhRvL..83.4974Y.

quiet: The crater statistics were taken from Icarus volume 128, page 99, and compared with newer imaging.
See Brown et al. (2004, ApJ, 600, 580) for the original derivation of the luminosity function.
Our reference list includes doi:10.1051/0004-6361:1995300, which first reported the line.
The preprint arXiv:1002.1234 points to the paper on galaxy mergers.
